command:
bash -s <<'ANTRIEB_NORMALIZE'
set -u
base=/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
manifest="$base/encodings.tsv"
outdir="$base/normalized"
install -d -m 0755 "$outdir"
error_tmp=$(mktemp "$base/.normalization-errors.tsv.XXXXXX") || exit 1
cleanup_files=
cleanup() {
  [ -z "$cleanup_files" ] || rm -f $cleanup_files
  [ ! -e "$error_tmp" ] || rm -f "$error_tmp"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf 'file\tencoding\terror\n' > "$error_tmp"
exec 3< "$manifest"
IFS= read -r header <&3 || { printf '%s\n' 'empty manifest' >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$header" = "file encoding" ] || [ "$header" = "file$(printf '\t')encoding" ] || { printf 'unexpected manifest header: %s\n' "$header" >&2; exit 1; }
while IFS="$(printf '\t')" read -r file encoding <&3; do
  [ -n "$file" ] || continue
  case "$file" in
    */*|.|..) printf '%s\t%s\tunsafe filename\n' "$file" "$encoding" >> "$error_tmp"; continue ;;
  esac
  src="$base/incoming/$file"
  dst="$outdir/$file"
  if [ ! -f "$src" ]; then
    printf '%s\t%s\tsource is not a regular file\n' "$file" "$encoding" >> "$error_tmp"
    continue
  fi
  decoded=$(mktemp "$outdir/.${file}.decoded.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  converted=$(mktemp "$outdir/.${file}.converted.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  diagnostic=$(mktemp "$base/.${file}.iconv.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  cleanup_files="$decoded $converted $diagnostic"
  if ! iconv -f "$encoding" -t UTF-8 "$src" > "$decoded" 2> "$diagnostic"; then
    message=$(tr '\n\t' '  ' < "$diagnostic")
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$file" "$encoding" "$message" >> "$error_tmp"
    rm -f "$decoded" "$converted" "$diagnostic"
    cleanup_files=
    continue
  fi
  LC_ALL=C sed 's/\r$//' "$decoded" > "$converted"
  if ! iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$converted" > /dev/null 2> "$diagnostic"; then
    message=$(tr '\n\t' '  ' < "$diagnostic")
    printf '%s\t%s\tpost-conversion UTF-8 validation failed: %s\n' "$file" "$encoding" "$message" >> "$error_tmp"
    rm -f "$decoded" "$converted" "$diagnostic"
    cleanup_files=
    continue
  fi
  chmod 0644 "$converted"
  mv -f "$converted" "$dst"
  rm -f "$decoded" "$diagnostic"
  cleanup_files=
  printf 'published %s (%s -> UTF-8, LF)\n' "$file" "$encoding"
done
mv -f "$error_tmp" "$base/normalization-errors.tsv"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' 'normalization pass complete'
ANTRIEB_NORMALIZE
status=$?
printf 'exit_status=%s\n' "$status"
exit "$status"

[ "$header_name" = file ] && [ "$header_encoding" = encoding ] && [ -z "${header_extra:-}" ] || { printf '%s\n' 'unexpected manifest header' >&2; exit 1; }
while read -r file encoding extra <&3; do
  [ -n "${file:-}" ] || continue
  if [ -z "${encoding:-}" ] || [ -n "${extra:-}" ]; then
    printf '%s\t%s\tmalformed manifest row\n' "$file" "${encoding:-}" >> "$error_tmp"
    continue
  fi
  case "$file" in
    */*|.|..) printf '%s\t%s\tunsafe filename\n' "$file" "$encoding" >> "$error_tmp"; continue ;;
  esac
  src="$base/incoming/$file"
  dst="$outdir/$file"
  if [ ! -f "$src" ]; then
    printf '%s\t%s\tsource is not a regular file\n' "$file" "$encoding" >> "$error_tmp"
    continue
  fi
  decoded=$(mktemp "$outdir/.${file}.decoded.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  converted=$(mktemp "$outdir/.${file}.converted.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  diagnostic=$(mktemp "$base/.${file}.iconv.XXXXXX") || exit 1
  cleanup_files="$decoded $converted $diagnostic"
  if ! iconv -f "$encoding" -t UTF-8 "$src" > "$decoded" 2> "$diagnostic"; then
    message=$(tr '\n\t' '  ' < "$diagnostic")
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$file" "$encoding" "$message" >> "$error_tmp"
    rm -f "$decoded" "$converted" "$diagnostic"
    cleanup_files=
    continue
  fi
  LC_ALL=C sed 's/\r$//' "$decoded" > "$converted"
  if ! iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 "$converted" > /dev/null 2> "$diagnostic"; then
    message=$(tr '\n\t' '  ' < "$diagnostic")
    printf '%s\t%s\tpost-conversion UTF-8 validation failed: %s\n' "$file" "$encoding" "$message" >> "$error_tmp"
    rm -f "$decoded" "$converted" "$diagnostic"
    cleanup_files=
    continue
  fi
  chmod 0644 "$converted"
  mv -f "$converted" "$dst"
  rm -f "$decoded" "$diagnostic"
  cleanup_files=
  printf 'published %s (%s -> UTF-8, LF)\n' "$file" "$encoding"
done
mv -f "$error_tmp" "$base/normalization-errors.tsv"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' 'normalization pass complete'
ANTRIEB_NORMALIZE
stdout:
published western.txt (ISO-8859-1 -> UTF-8, LF)
published utf8.txt (UTF-8 -> UTF-8, LF)
normalization pass complete

command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization
cd "$base"
printf '%s\n' '--- published files and error report ---'
find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f\t%s bytes\n' | sort
cat normalization-errors.tsv

  [ -f "$f" ] || continue

  cr=$(LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\r' < "$f" | wc -c)
  lf=$(LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\n' < "$f" | wc -c)
  last=$(tail -c 1 "$f" | od -An -tu1 | tr -d ' ')
  [ -n "$last" ] || last=EMPTY
  printf '%s: UTF-8=valid CR=%s LF=%s last_byte_decimal=%s\n' "$name" "$cr" "$lf" "$last"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- exact normalized bytes (accented text and empty record) ---'
for f in normalized/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; printf '%s\n' "[$(basename "$f")]"; od -An -tx1c "$f"; done
printf '%s\n' '--- atomicity/invalid-output checks ---'
test ! -e normalized/invalid.txt && printf '%s\n' 'invalid.txt output absent'
if find normalized -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '.*.??????' | grep -q .; then printf '%s\n' 'unexpected temporary files' >&2; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'no temporary/partial files'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- source SHA-256 after normalization ---'
sha256sum encodings.tsv incoming/*
